title: fix: escape backslashes before parentheses in URL replacement logic
body: ## :bookmark_tabs: Summary Fixes unsafe or incomplete string escaping in URL manipulation logic by ensuring backslashes are escaped before other characters like parentheses. Resolves #6565 PS. This is the proof why this PR fixes the issues when running CodeQL on my forked repo. --- ## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions - The bug was surfaced via CodeQL and relates to escaping parentheses in a string without first escaping existing backslashes. - To ensure correctness and avoid malformed escape sequences, the fix applies `.replace(/\\/g, '\\\\')` before replacing other special characters. - This avoids issues where characters like `\(` are incorrectly interpreted or break rendering/parsing. - The change is minimal and scoped to the URL-escaping logic in `edges.js`. **Example of corrected code:** ```js url = url.replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/\(/g, '\\(').replace(/\)/g, '\\)'); ``` This order of replacements ensures robust and predictable escaping. --- ### :clipboard: Tasks Make sure you: - [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html) - [ ] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests. - [ ] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html#update-documentation) is used for all new features. - [x] :butterfly: If your PR makes a change that should be noted in one or more packages' changelogs, generate a changeset by running `pnpm changeset` and following the prompts. Changesets that add features should be `minor` and those that fix bugs should be `patch`. Please prefix changeset messages with `fix:`.
author: arpitjain099

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
I think instead of using `url = url.replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/\(/g, '\\(').replace(/\)/g, '\\)');`, we might want to use [`CSS.escape()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/CSS/escape_static).

It looks like we're trying to create valid [`CSS <url-token>`](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-syntax-3/#typedef-url-token), as these are passed unquoted to the [SVG/CSS `url()` function](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/url_function). `CSS.escape` will probably overly escape characters, but it's probably cleaner and describes what we want to do better.

There's other characters that are valid in a URI like `'`, but aren't valid in a CSS `<url-token>` so they should be escaped too.

comments.author: arpitjain099
comments.body:
@aloisklink I have updated the function to use CSS.escape and replaced hardcoded occurrences with common function getUrl. Please review.
cc: @sidharthv96

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
How's this?

```suggestion
fix: Fix incomplete string escaping in URL manipulation logic when `arrowMarkerAbsolute: true` by ensuring all unsafe characters are escaped.
```

- I've removed `unsafe` since this code is already escaped in the HTML. The bug you're fixing means that if you have a URL like: `http://localhost:9000/flowchart.html?hi=world(%20\)`, the arrow markers will now be correct.

  E.g. something like the following would still be a valid SVG, but the `url()` is invalid so the arrows won't be proper (and an additional `url(javascript:)` won't do anything so there shouldn't be any XSS attack possible):

  ```svg
  <path
    d="M196.238,47L196.238,51.167C196.238,55.333,196.238,63.667,196.238,71.333C196.238,79,196.238,86,196.238,89.5L196.238,93"
    id="L_A_B_0"
    class=" edge-thickness-thick edge-pattern-solid edge-thickness-normal edge-pattern-solid flowchart-link"
    style="stroke:gold; stroke-width:4px;fill:none;"
    marker-end="url(http://localhost:9000/flowchart.html?hi=world\(%20\\)#mermaid-1747046847808_flowchart-v2-pointEnd_gold)"></path>
  ```

- I also added ```when `arrowMarkerAbsolute: true` ``` since that's the only case where this bug appears.
- And I changed `ensuring backslashes are escaped` to `ensuring all unsafe characters are escaped` since your PR also fixes escaping `'`/`"`/ and whitespace.
